scope: Expand the mock-only Oyatie Cloud/Tenant Control Center Leptos prototype from scaffold into a full dashboard while preserving server-derived render-envelope constraints.
implemented_changes: Added serializable tenant/role/accreditation-aware TenantRenderEnvelope data types and SSR/test-only mock envelope derivation.
Added an SSR-only mock server catalog sentinel and kept the full catalog behind cfg(feature = "ssr").
Reworked the app into an SSR-first shell with a selective Leptos/WASM dashboard island rooted at #oya-dashboard-island-root.
Added /api/render-envelope/<context-id> to return one permitted render envelope at a time for context switching.
Implemented full mock dashboard surfaces: metrics, daily tasks, schedule, messenger/mail, approvals, permitted modules, Workflow Studio canvas, ontology explanation, and advisory assistant.
Copied the generated Visual Ralph reference image into .omx/artifacts/visual-ralph/oya-full-dashboard/ and captured Playwright screenshots for the implemented route.

verification.command: strings target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/{crate artifacts} | grep -E 'SERVER_ONLY_CATALOG_SENTINEL_DO_NOT_SHIP_TO_BROWSER_WASM|Clinical Home|Patient Schedule|Care Workflows'
verification.summary: Server-only sentinel and healthcare-only sample strings were absent from current browser/WASM release artifacts.

verification.command: podman run docker.io/library/rust:1.95-bookworm cargo run --locked -p oya-application-shell-frontend-prototype --no-default-features --features ssr; curl route and envelope APIs
verification.summary: Root rendered #prototype-shell and #oya-dashboard-island-root; corporate-office envelope excluded Clinical Home; healthcare-clinician envelope included Clinical Home.
Full-page visual evidence captured for the local SSR route.

non_claims: No real authentication, backend integration, PHI/PII handling, or workflow execution is implemented.
No full repository ./bin/oya verify --ci-required success is claimed; this evidence is scoped to the application shell frontend prototype slice.
The Visual Ralph reference is a working target artifact; pixel-perfect parity is not claimed.

facets.F1_source_grounding: Grounded in the user-provided frontend objective, Leptos/cargo metadata, current crate files, and generated Visual Ralph reference.
facets.F2_tests_and_gates: Package fmt, tests, WASM builds, hydrate build, SSR build, sentinel/string leak check, Podman smoke, API smoke, and Playwright screenshot capture passed.
facets.F3_security_privacy: Mock-only dashboard; no real auth/backend/PHI/PII; browser artifacts do not contain the server-only catalog sentinel or healthcare-only sample modules.
facets.F4_architecture: SSR/server derives permitted render envelopes; browser island fetches one permitted envelope by context instead of receiving and hiding the full catalog.
facets.F5_operability: Podman local server launches with docker.io/library/rust:1.95-bookworm and exposes root plus /api/render-envelope/<context-id>.
facets.F6_rollback: All changes are confined to the prototype crate, root workspace membership/dependency lock updates, registry catalog row, and visual evidence artifacts.
facets.F7_user_impact: Provides a serious cloud/tenant control center mock dashboard with no-code workflow and daily-work surfaces.
facets.F8_observability: Evidence captured through tests, smoke logs, screenshot artifacts, and this multispectrum JSON.
facets.F9_dependency: Adds serde/serde_json and wasm browser bindings needed for serializable envelopes and selective island fetches; no React/xyflow fallback.
facets.F10_claim_honesty: Claims are limited to the mock prototype; full repository verification and production readiness are explicitly nonclaimed.
facets.F11_docs: client-manifest.json documents the full dashboard, selective island model, dev commands, non-goals, and visual reference.
facets.F13_followup: If cargo-leptos is installed, run cargo leptos build --release from the prototype crate to produce the /pkg glue for hydrated browser interaction.
